SKYD.headline: Stock Market Today, Oct. 14: Skydance Warrants Begin Separate Trading Today: SKYD Stock Drops 24%
SKYD.description: Skydance (SKYD) stock fell 24% on October 14, 2026, after 471 million warrants began trading separately from the company's shares on the ex-distribution date. The warrants, issued to former Paramount shareholders, allow them to purchase SKYD shares at $12 each through 2036. If fully exercised, this would generate $5.7 billion but dilute shares by roughly 10%.
